BiblicalUsage: Ehi is a son of Benjamin, named once in the list of Jacob's family that went down into Egypt. His name means my brother, and beyond that single mention we know nothing more about him. He travelled with the family into a foreign land, and his name survives in the genealogy.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts every member of the family, even the ones named only once. Ehi went down to Egypt with the rest, and he was part of the promise all the same.
